# GOTO Toastmasters

> A Toastmasters International dinner club in the Melbourne CBD, Australia, that meets approximately monthly on a Tuesday evening for dinner and a meeting to build public speaking and leadership skills.

## Key pages

- [Welcome](https://gototoastmasters.com.au/): who we are and how to visit
- [Upcoming events](https://gototoastmasters.com.au/events/): meeting dates and guest registration
- [The Pitch](https://gototoastmasters.com.au/pitch/): membership criteria, meeting format and pricing
- [Meeting roles](https://gototoastmasters.com.au/roles/): what each meeting role involves
- [Join](https://gototoastmasters.com.au/join/): membership sign-up form

## Contact

- Email: goto.toastmasters.committee@gmail.com
